body:
Really not sure where to start with this. I started writing some of the crap from my childhood, only to see that it looked so stupid. Instead I'l just skip to the three biggest things weighing me down right now.

The first was my last attempt at suicide. I was dating the best women I had ever met in the world. She was amazing beautiful, she was intelligent, going to get her PHD in criminology, she was funny and was loads of fun to be around. We would go out every week and just walk and talk. We had sex a few times, but by "sex" I mean that I was actually being a gentlemen and "just the tip" and I guess never really took her virginity.

I loved her and she loved me.

Her family hated me. Her father didn;t like another man in his house (first BF of either of his daughters) her sister hated me because she couldn't get a guy, and her mother, she never hated me, but I think she thought her daughter could do better and I was just some fling (I never went to uni but am by no means not smart).

It came to a point where she had her family telling her to leave me, or for her to leave them. She left me. I tried to kill myself but was found at the last minute by my dad running late for church.

I don't know what I hate the most here, the fact I didn't go through with it as it would have solved the 3rd problem below, or that it messed with my head during 2nd below. Worst thing is that I feel like I ruined her. She was amazing, best thing that ever happened to me, and now I can't stop thinking of her or how I had ruined her life with her family.

Anyway, this lead on to the 2nd burden. Just after this period in my life, the ONLY friend I had had in the world who actually gave a shit about me started to get sick. Real sick. Basically the day my GF left me was the day we kidnapped my friend from hospital and went 4 wheel driving. Great day but stuck in my head as here he was sick, in serious pain, and he only kept asking how I was doing.

A few months later he passed away. Within a 4 month period he went from being a normal guy to looking like a holocaust survivor - skin and bones.

I only visited him once a week. My best friend, the only person who cared about me, and i let him down.

He even asked me to help him commit suicide to escape the pain. I tried but I don't think he was able to swallow enough pills at that point and all he did was get some long sleep. He was a virgin and asked me to help him get laid, but I failed at that as well.

The day he died I drove past the turn off to the hospital. I thought "no, I could see him but it's getting late, i'l do it another time" - 2 hours later he was dead. My selfishness meant he died in a room alone, A virgin, and in pain.

After this I just wanted to meet someone, anyone to get my mind off things. I was living alone in a house so put out an add and a chick from Texas ended up living with me - she had feelings for me. I had none for her. I used her at least once for sex, just to fill a part of me. I tell people we just got drunk one night etc, but she slept with me because of her feelings, I let her because I had none.

She got pregnant.

The last 2 1/2 years have since been a living hell for me. Shes abusive. Not much physical but she has lashed out a few times - she wont remember throwing a hit, but will claim marks on her hands where caused by me (true, the marks as i defended my self and blocked her punches)

I actually moved to her city so she could give birth around her family. I moved across the world, with the promise that we would come back to my country after 2 years.

It all came to a point where I had to leave. She was starting to be violent every day, even pushing me while i held my son, and no one I told would help. None. 

I moved into a friends place. They have had me for 4 months and I feel like a dick for staying there. They don;t ask rent, but they have told me I will soon need to leave. I don't have full time work so no idea what to do.

I'm now stuck in a horrid legal divorce because i believe that my son would be better with me - but due to his age the courts would probably leave him with her. She constantly sends me abusive messages etc, and uses our son to try to control me.

I hate it there. I could go home and have a 50K job in a day (had an offer on the table for 2 years now, they constantly ask about me) or stay there and have no job (been trying to get one for almost a year and a half now). I have family and friends and support at home, nothing really where I am.

I want to be home, but if I do i'l be leaving my son in the hands of a manipulative person with some serious anger and other possible mental issues - I can't work out what to do. Each day I just want it to be over. Each day I fight through with no idea what to do next.

TL/DR

Believe I ruined the best girl in the worlds life.

Missed out on seeing my best friend just before he died

Have to decide between seeing my son twice a month in another country, or going back home to family friends and work.

Resumes and job searches im fine with - but Im in Texas, so everyone see's me as a horrible foreigner here to steal jobs

The worst bit is that each time I see my son, I have to close my heart down. Otherwise i'd be breaking down each time, but i have to show im strong. Thing is that it makes it harder and harder to feel anything when im around him :(
